demos.title: AlphaNIST simple insertions
demos.description: A pretrained policy inserts three loose pegs on a complete NIST board. Drag a loose peg to perturb its approach.

demos.title: Pulley workshop
demos.description: Pull the cable, change the load, and watch the forces. Compare an ideal rope, a flexible cable, and a frictional tendon.

ropeModels.label: Massless rope
ropeModels.description: An ideal rope with no mass or friction. Explore mechanical advantage.

ropeModels.label: VBD cable
ropeModels.description: A physical cable with mass, bending and surface contact.

ropeModels.label: Newton tendon
ropeModels.description: A tendon sliding over non-rotating guides. Add friction and stretch.

demos.title: VBD cable bending
demos.description: A shorter clamped cable that settles. Tune stiffness and the tip load.

demos.title: Franka cable policy
demos.description: A pretrained policy grasps and lifts a cable through real contacts. Change the target height or take over with keyboard IK.

demos.title: Franka soft-body policy
demos.description: A pretrained VBD policy grasps and lifts a flexible beam. Change the target, tune stiffness, or pull the beam.

demos.title: Franka cloth policy
demos.description: A pretrained VBD policy grasps a cloth sheet with real contacts. Change bending or target height and test recovery.

demos.title: Franka cube stacking
demos.description: Stack cubes with a scripted controller, or take over the arm with keyboard IK.

demos.title: VBD material stiffness
demos.description: Adjust shear, volume stiffness, damping, and gravity on three deformable cubes.

demos.title: VBD cloth bending
demos.description: Compare cloth sheets draping over rollers with different bending stiffness.

demos.title: MJWarp sliding friction
demos.description: Change friction on an incline and compare sliding motion with fixed references.

demos.title: Joint PD tuning
demos.description: Tune a suspended arm using step and sine commands and a live tracking plot.

demos.title: MPM material response
demos.description: Drop 2,744 fine particles onto a cylinder. Try sand, snow, clay, and water references.

demos.title: Cartpole balancing
demos.description: Push a pretrained balancing policy with up to 300 N in either direction.

demos.title: G1 velocity control
demos.description: Command travel and yaw using the published WBC-AGILE policy.

demos.title: ANYmal-D velocity control
demos.description: Drive a published Isaac Lab Newton policy with travel and yaw controls.

demos.title: Franka reach
demos.description: Move the target and watch a pretrained joint-position policy reach for it.

demos.title: Franka lift
demos.description: Watch a pretrained policy lift a cube and adjust its target position.

demos.title: Franka drawer opening
demos.description: Play, pause, and reset a pretrained drawer-opening policy.

demos.title: MicroDuck walking
demos.description: Walk through a warehouse using native BAM servos. Steer around its colliders, nudge movable props, or give the robot a gentle mouse push.

demos.title: Domino cascade
demos.description: Topple 24 slabs with a short push. Change friction and compare the cascade.
